dashboard.label: lab-vm SSH and web activity
dashboard.description: Failed SSH logins, brute force, odd logins and web scanning on my lab VM

search.query: index=main sourcetype=linux_secure "Failed password" | timechart span=5m count as failed_logins
index=main sourcetype=linux_secure "Failed password" | rex "Failed password for (invalid user )?(?<user>\S+) from" | top limit=10 user

index=main sourcetype=linux_secure "Failed password" | rex "Failed password for (invalid user )?(?<user>\S+) from (?<src_ip>\S+)" | bin _time span=5m | stats count as failures dc(user) as users_tried by _time src_ip | where failures >= 10 | sort - failures

index=main sourcetype=linux_secure ("Failed password" OR "Accepted") | rex "(?<result>Failed|Accepted) (password|publickey) for (invalid user )?(?<user>\S+) from (?<src_ip>\S+)" | sort 0 _time | streamstats time_window=10m count(eval(result="Failed")) as failures_last_10m by src_ip | where result="Accepted" AND failures_last_10m >= 5 | table _time src_ip user failures_last_10m

index=main sourcetype=linux_secure "Accepted" | rex "Accepted (?<method>password|publickey) for (?<user>\S+) from (?<src_ip>\S+)" | where NOT (user="scanner" AND src_ip="10.10.10.1" AND method="password") | eval hour=tonumber(strftime(_time, "%H")), day=strftime(_time, "%a") | where hour < 8 OR hour >= 18 OR day="Sat" OR day="Sun" | stats count as logins by user src_ip method
index=main sourcetype=access_combined status=404 | bin _time span=5m | stats count as not_found dc(uri_path) as different_paths by _time clientip | where not_found >= 50 | sort - not_found
